title: Glass from Manthai, Sri Lanka: Insights into the supply of glass for the Silk Roads
scope: LA-ICP-MS composition and glass working at Manthai
limitations: Strong for compositional groups and secondary working; absence of primary-production evidence at Manthai is not proof of island-wide absence.

title: The trading of ancient glass beads: new analytical data from South Asian and Southeast Asian glass beads
scope: Compositional comparison including Giribawa raw glass, furnace materials and beads
limitations: Comparative archaeometry; production interpretation remains site-specific and should not be generalized to all Sri Lankan ports.

title: Glass Production in Sri Lanka
scope: Survey and research synthesis on Sri Lankan primary and secondary glass production
limitations: Research synthesis with open questions; does not collapse all glass-working sites into primary-production centres.

title: Taprobane
author_or_institution: Ian C. Glover / Oxford Classical Dictionary
author_institution: Ian C. Glover / Oxford Classical Dictionary
scope: Literary and archaeological summary of Mediterranean–Sri Lankan exchange chronology
limitations: Reference synthesis; individual literary episodes and coin finds require source-specific treatment.

title: Sites portuaires et emporia de l'ancien Sri Lanka
scope: Ports, numismatics and long-distance exchange in ancient Sri Lanka
limitations: Archaeological/numismatic synthesis; object presence does not by itself prove direct voyages.

title: The Evolution of an Ethnic Identity: The Tamils in Sri Lanka, excerpts in The Sri Lanka Reader
scope: First-millennium evidence and limits of reconstructing Tamil/Nāga populations
limitations: Modern scholarly reconstruction; material evidence for ethnic labels remains narrow and contested.

title: Sinhala Nationalism
scope: Historiography and political construction of Sinhala nationalism
limitations: Modern nationalism focus; not evidence for ancient Nāga ethnicity.

title: Sri Lanka: Sinhala Nationalism and the Elusive Southern Consensus
limitations: Policy/conflict analysis; useful for reception history, not ancient reconstruction.

title: Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance No. 2 of 1937

author_institution: Wildlife and Nature Protection Society of Sri Lanka

author_institution: Department of Wildlife Conservation Sri Lanka

author_institution: International Review of Social History / Cambridge University Press
